nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Normative modeling uses four DTI microstructural measures (FA, MD, RD, AxD) projected along tractography streamlines; macrostructure (streamline geometry) is modeled jointly.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: After processing dMRI, diffusion tensors were fitted at each voxel using the non-linear least-squares method to produce FA, MD, RD, and AxD scalar maps in the dMRI native space.; As shown in Figure 2C, MINT is trained on whole-brain macrostructure as well as the four standard DTI microstructural measures.
